instruction.text: Assign the correct sentence to the reason simple present is used.

atoms.a: Ereignisse, die nach einem Zeitplan ablaufen
atoms.b: The train to Berlin leaves the station at 9:45 pm.

atoms.a: Nebensätze, die einen Moment in der Zukunft benennen
atoms.b: I will board the train <u>as soon as</u> it arrives at the station.
If we catch the train, we will get to Berlin in time to go clubbing.

atoms.a: Tomorrow, our shop opens at 10 a.m. instead of 8 a.m.
If Minna will go to the party, I will join too.

wrong.text: Bei einem if-clause Typ 1 wird im Nebensatz simple present verwendet.

atoms.b: If Minna ((goes)) to the party, I will join too.

atoms.a: <u>Until</u> Benji will arrive, his friends have to wait.

wrong.text: Bei einem Nebensatz, der mit der Konjunktion until eingeleitet wird, wird simple present verwendet.

atoms.b: <u>Until</u> Benji ((arrives)), his friends have to wait.

atoms.a: If you buy the tickets in time, we will get to enjoy the concert later.
<u>Before</u> Alice's get-together will start, she will cook food for everyone.

wrong.text: Bei einem Nebensatz, der mit der Konjunktion before eingeleitet wird, wird simple present verwendet.

atoms.b: <u>Before</u> Alice's get-together ((starts)), she will cook food for everyone.

atoms.a: Our meeting begins at 6 p.m. today.

instruction.text: Fill in the correct verbs, using the simple present.

atoms.b: The café ((opens)) at 10 a.m. tomorrow and we will meet there for brunch. If anybody ((arrives)) early, they will get us a table. <u>When</u> the waiter ((comes)), we will order some coffee. If anyone ((orders)) tea, the barista will prepare it on request.

The match ((starts)) at 8 tonight, so we will meet at the pub. If Mark ((finishes)) his shift on time, he will join us. As soon as the bar ((opens)), we might grab some snacks. If someone ((needs)) a drink, the bartender will bring some soda to our table.

We will meet at the outdoor cinema tonight, because the screening of my favourite film ((begins)) at 9 p.m. If Lena ((brings)) blankets, the group will spread them on the grass. We will sit down when the lights ((go_down)). Until the film ((ends)), we will enjoy the cinema's atmosphere. If the weather ((stays)) dry, sitting outside will not be a problem.
